craft_notes: Sthāyin: vīra of proclamation — the hammer now proclaims: breath demoted → rest unfolds → Māyā named → mother proclaimed → fence → double-held VERDICT. Self-singing verse: sung as I-ness — the song knows it sings; I-blocking kept packed. Rejected: (a) called for sung → killed: sung is the verse’s own verb. (b) unpacking I-blocking → killed: row-2 pressure. Read aloud: NO-ord-er-ing OF-things LIES in-BREATH … IS-sung AS-I-ness.

lines: No ordering of things lies in breath by I-blocking —
shining's self-rest is sung as I-ness.
l4.sanskrit_cite: nārthavyavasthā prāṇādāv ahaṃbhāvanirodhataḥ prakāśasyātmaviśrāntir ahaṃbhāvo hi kīrtitaḥ

reads_against.argmap: Where lies the ordering of things? → Order is not in breath but in I-ness: shining's self-rest, sung as the orderer.
c1_essence: Breath, body, and the eightfold city are demoted to knowables: no ordering lies in breath, no restraint touches the self, and living-ness stands beyond non-showing (vv19-22).

Rest unfolds into freedom, doership, lordship; Māyā named from power alone; the beginningless mother-principle proclaimed; pervasion fenced to I-sharers; the world verdict that-nondual-made (vv23-27).
